name: prepare_application_brief
description: Stage a confirmed, non-sensitive nurse work-preference brief in the candidate's browser. This does not submit an application, create a candidate record, or contact a recruiter.

workType.description: Travel, per diem, local contract, or another work type.

preferredLocation.description: Preferred city, state, region, or travel radius.

payPreference.description: Candidate-stated pay preference or constraint, never a promised rate.

fitNotes.description: Non-sensitive priorities, constraints, or deal breakers.
